messages:
priya: Kickoff for ACME 'Gridiron' perf/W + kernel-tune sweep. Goal: baseline power vs throughput across ACME A100-Next boards, confirm quantization profile and roll plan. See kickoff doc https://go/redwood/partnerships/gridiron-kickoff

sam: +1 — can do dry-run. I can book Delta lab for Tue morning (US-PST). Who needs access to the reserved pool?

acme-eng: Thanks — we'll prep BIOS settings and the latest firmware. Quick Q: which kernel and ROCm/driver stack are we standardizing on for the sweep?

natalie: For the preview we used kernel 6.1.8 with our small RCU patch. Recommend 6.1.9-rc1 for the full sweep (stability + perf counters). I'll paste the run snippet below.

natalie: ```bash
# bench loop
./scripts/run_profile.sh --model=llama-7b --seq=512 --iter=20 --power-sample=1s --out=gridiron/llama-512.json
```

leo: Add these to the data capture checklist: /sys/class/hwmon/*, ipmitool sensor logs, nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw, per-socket rails. Also collect perf counters: L2_RQSTS.MISS, LLC_REFERENCES, and memory bandwidth.

bench-bot: automated: please tag run artifacts with run_id and firmware_sha. Template: run_id=<YYYYMMDD>-<board>-<v> and firmware_sha=sha256:<hash>

priya: Ops note: we'll use the "reserved-dedicated" pool to avoid noisy neighbors. Sam — can you coordinate capacity reservation with infra and post the reservation id here? We'll pin model weights to v1.2 for comparability.

sam: Will do. Also propose we capture two kernel variants: stock + acme-prefetch-patch (small L1 prefetch change). That way we can A/B.

acme-eng: We have a prefetch candidate that boosted perf/W ~3-4% in internal sims. Happy to canary on two boards first. Firmware images and checksums will be uploaded to S3 once ready.

leo: Canary + A/B sounds good. For traffic shaping: use synthetic seq distribution with 10% prefix-cache hits to mimic our app load. Also keep batch sizes consistent (batch=1 streaming + batch=8 offline).

natalie: I'll assemble the prompt set and the eval harness (latency P99, throughput, and quality regression checks). Expect ~0.5 day dry-run, full sweep ~48 hours once we have stable firmware.

priya: Action items: sam reserve capacity + post id; acme-eng provision firmware and board tags; natalie publish run manifest; leo produce perf profile + sensor list. I'll consolidate into kickoff doc and send calendar invite.

sam: Reservation posted: res-2026-06-18-gridiron-1 (internal link) :thumbsup:

acme-eng: Firmware uploaded: s3://acme-grid/firmware/v3.2.1.sha256=abcd1234 (will attach board tags/serials in the manifest)

natalie: Run manifest added: https://go/redwood/bench/gridiron/manifest.md — includes env matrix, kernels, fw, and metric collectors.

priya: Thanks team — dry-run Tue 09:00 PT. Ping here if anything blocks.

bench-bot: scheduled dry-run: Tue 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to participants.
